candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Pikin no get cough and e no get wahala to breathe. Pikin dey get diarrhoea. Pikin dey get ear wahala. Pikin no get fever. Pikin no dey convulse now. Pikin never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. Pikin no dey vomit everything. Blood no dey for pikin stool. Pikin no dey restless or irritable. When dem pinch pikin skin, e normal. Pikin eye dey sunk. Diarrhoea don last for 3 days. Dem no see ear discharge for pikin. Pikin no dey feel ear pain. Pus no dey come out from pikin ear. Swelling wey dey pain dey behind pikin ear.
